big: Dadi wants gold but does not want a locker, a theft risk or making charges. A fund that holds gold on her behalf could solve this. But not every paper gold product is the same, and one is not regulated by SEBI at all.

lines: Can I own gold without holding it in my hand?
Yes, in a few forms. A gold ETF trades like a share. A gold fund of funds needs no demat account. Digital gold is sold by apps, but is not regulated by SEBI, so the seller matters.

q: Rohan has a demat account and wants gold that trades like a share. What fits?
why: A fixed deposit is a bank product with no link to gold.
A gold ETF holds gold and trades on the exchange.
A treasury bill is a short-term government security.
A term plan is insurance and has no link to gold.

q: Meena has no demat account but wants gold through a mutual fund. What fits?
why: A gold ETF needs a demat account to hold units.
A gold loan is borrowing against gold and not an investment in it.
A coin from a stranger is a risk, with no check on purity.
A gold fund of funds can be bought without a demat account.
